item.title: Intune announces future iOS/iPadOS 18 and macOS 15 support minimums — 25 June 2026
item.description:

Intune announces future iOS/iPadOS 18 and macOS 15 support minimums

Microsoft plans to require iOS/iPadOS 18 or later and support macOS 15 or later after Apple’s 2026 platform releases; the announcements include distinct treatment for existing and new enrollments.

Intune · App management

iOS and iPadOS 18 support minimum is planned

After Apple’s iOS/iPadOS 27 release, Intune plans to require iOS/iPadOS 18 or later; organizations should identify affected devices and note separate requirements for userless ADE devices.

Intune · Device enrollment

macOS 15 support minimum is planned

After macOS Golden Gate 27, Intune plans to support macOS 15 and later; existing devices on macOS 14.x or lower can remain enrolled, but new enrollments on those versions will not be allowed.
